description: Dump the memory store as JSON, JSONL, or Markdown. Optional since/until window on updated_at. Use for backup/inspection. Requires explicit_user_intent: true.

explicit_user_intent.description: Must be true. Set ONLY when the current user message explicitly asks the agent to modify memory (set/forget/export). Do not infer intent.

format.description: Output format: json (single object), jsonl (one entry per line), markdown (human-friendly).

since.description: Unix ms timestamp — include only entries with updated_at >= since.

until.description: Unix ms timestamp — include only entries with updated_at <= until.

name: memory_export
